title: Remote scalar device heals Herrera

tellings.quote: So, the first scan took 12 12 and a half hours. I was in this chair and they were sitting there working like literally overnight.

plain: A former Navy sailor named Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot craft in the Indonesian jungle, says he was healed by a device described as "scalar," worked from a distance, with the first scan taking 12 to 12 and a half hours while he sat in a chair and the operators worked overnight. Herrera tells this as his own experience. He tells it as proof of an unusual healing technology.
